_readme: Identity duplicates fixed upstream (COLLECTION.md §8), consumed by build-company-base.py at the one scheduled rebuild. Non-canonical slugs carry duplicate_of; the canonical carries no exclusion flag. Every pair here was found during the grind and flagged on the row with `suspected_duplicate` rather than merged silently. Three causes on this run: renames the archive captured on both sides of the change, the 2010-2014 chart's short display names against the WordPress era's full ones, and four scrape artifacts where the 2025 Webflow page title 'Khosla Ventures - <Company>' was taken as the company name.
